full_name: Tomasz Mrowka | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Tomasz Mrowka is the Singer Professor of Mathematics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. He studies the Yang-Mills equations and other partial differential equations of high-energy physics and is particularly interested in their applications to the study of low-dimensional topology.
